hero.title: Bring customers back—visit after visit
hero.description: Want more guests who return again and again? Sheeper gives your venue a digital loyalty card customers actually use. Get in touch and we’ll walk you through it.
hero.image_aria: Sheeper app: digital loyalty cards with stamps and rewards

what_we_do.title: What we do
what_we_do.lead: Sheeper is the app where digital loyalty cards live. People collect stamps at places they love and unlock rewards you define—simple for guests, clear for you.
what_we_do.point1: Customers discover your venue and keep every stamp in one app.
what_we_do.point2: Each visit adds a stamp; you choose the reward and the rules.
what_we_do.point3: They redeem on-site—no lost cards, no extra plastic.

for_businesses_section.title: For your business
for_businesses_section.loyalty_text: Repeat customers spend more and recommend you. A loyalty programme rewards regulars, fills quieter hours, and gives people a reason to choose you again instead of trying somewhere new.
for_businesses_section.digital_text: Paper cards get lost, torn, or forgotten. Digital cards live in the customer’s phone, are always with them, and are easier to run for you — no printing, no manual stamp books, and updates in one place.
